source_reader_view.task: Inspect the full visible constructions in the supplied fixed pair list from original source pixels, recording source facts and concrete ownership evidence before historical claims are revealed.
source_reader_view.source: Only source257; supplied geometry and cohort selection condition the inspection. No historical feature prose, pair outcomes, group labels or old reader claims may be read before BOTH initial source-reader reports are frozen.
source_reader_view.frames: Right-region writing exact90CW only; bottom/frozen native. No arbitrary rotation/mirroring, scaling, filtering, enhancement, segmentation, OCR, retouching or image generation.
source_reader_view.pixel_gate: Independently compare every reused native crop and saved paired panel against original source crop/exact90CW BEFORE first view. Pixel fidelity is not target-binding proof. Labels remain outside source pixels.
route_evidence: Use approved target/base search rectangles only as locators, not contours or ownership masks. Follow the actual complete source route through full context; record competing neighboring routes.

For each target record all visible free ends, bars, returns and their junctions in native-coordinate search regions; distinguish continuous target ink, neighboring ink, bounded detached target marks, and unresolved ownership.
A missing feature requires adequate positive full-route/end visibility on both compared targets. Occlusion, blur, cropped boundary or UNKNOWN cannot establish absence.

Record all eight source-specific features and variations even for deferred pair outcomes. Reuse per-target facts with explicit actual pair-board views; do not manufacture pair inspection by combinatorial prose.

outcomes.SAME_FULL_VISIBLE_FEATURE_CANDIDATE: All eight complete paired source features and target-owned adjuncts are positively compatible under the fixed significant-feature rule; no missing/unknown wildcard or body-only match. This reader candidate is not a released edge until the remaining review gates pass.
outcomes.DIFFERENT_FULL_VISIBLE_GRAPHICS: Positively visible target-owned incompatible topology, enclosure, attachment, or terminal presence, with full relevant ends visible on BOTH targets. A graphical difference is not a cipher cannot-link or proof of different letter identity.
outcomes.VISIBLE_VARIATION_RELATION_UNRESOLVED: A direction, extent, bar-height, arm, curl or return variation is observed but its identity significance is unvalidated; do not force either equality or a negative identity claim.
outcomes.CONNECTION_OR_BINDING_UNRESOLVED: Name the exact unreadable/ambiguous connection, end, mark allocation or target-versus-neighbor route at source coordinates and state which observation is missing.

source_reader_view.variation_rule: Translation, photographic texture, thickness/taper and small contour variation may be recorded only where significant topology, attachments, returns and terminal relations remain positively supported. Upper curl, bar height, terminal direction/length, relative arms and narrow returns are not automatically nuisance variation. No numeric threshold is fitted to force a match.
source_reader_view.freeze_rule: Each fresh reader freezes its initial observations and whole-pair outcomes before seeing the other initial report or any historical feature/outcome claims. Record prior exposure. Later historical comparisons/corrections are separate immutable addenda and do not count as initial blind agreement.
source_reader_view.semantic_limits: No letters, functional/cipher roles, alphabet partition, transitive equivalence, new global reading order or source258/222. Separate AI on the same original pixels is not external expert validation or independent-source corroboration.
source_reader_view.geometry_limits: Native boxes are approximate search regions, not ink masks. Region display order and projection order are not reading order; overlapping envelopes do not establish aliases or separate glyphs.

initial_blinding: Only the source_reader_view subsection plus sanitized geometry/intake may be supplied to fresh readers. Full protocol contains historical conditioning and is withheld until both initial reports plus viewed-board/proof identities are frozen. Historical claim prose, outcomes, acceptance/conflict counts and group IDs remain withheld. Source/cohort geometry conditioning and any exposure are disclosed.
release_gate: A new SAME edge needs both independently frozen fresh-reader support on all eight full target-owned features and a separate final AI source check. New DIFFERENT_FULL_VISIBLE_GRAPHICS needs both readers plus final source checking of an actual incompatible invariant. Final checking occurs after reports, not blind corroboration. Any conflict or missing ownership/visibility proof retains a specific unresolved state; no majority-vote forcing.
historical_correction_audit: After BOTH initial freezes, reveal only relevant historical claims. Every claimed correction names the exact old artifact SHA and JSON pointer, the old literal source fact, the corrected fact and native witness/route/ownership evidence. A new reader disagreement alone is not a correction. Preserve original files and all disagreements; post-feedback addenda are separately frozen.
dependency_impact: D12 historical graph remains immutable. A concrete correction that contradicts an authoritative feature/target fact supporting an existing accepted edge must identify exactly the dependent edge and authority. Quarantine only actually undermined current claims unless the existing final source evidence already accounts for the corrected fact. Do not silently inherit a known-wrong claim or repeat all58 accepted comparisons; no new old-old closure pass. Mark unvalidated dependent claims explicitly rather than transitive recomputation of evidence.
fixed_prior_scope: Do not rerun completed15 eligibility/ownership work, the prior full70 inventory or old optimizer/corpus/control experiments. A comparison-specific binding uncertainty is local evidence, not an implicit eligibility rewrite. No outside exclusion search/promotion is authorized in this pass.
conditional772_barrier: All38 initial inspections, historical claim audits and final per-pair dispositions must exist before optional comparison selection, including legitimate unresolved outcomes. No new source views for a772 pair before its exact pair IDs and new witness rationale are prelogged.
conditional772_admission: A candidate must be one of the exact772 D12 rows with PRESCREEN_WITH_SINGLE_READER_DERIVED_CONTRAST_NOT_ACCEPTED_NEGATIVE and no direct paired inspection. Admission requires a NEW source-specific discriminating witness from the38 review plus a concrete other-profile witness supporting plausible agreement of ALL eight significant features, including terminals/bars/returns/owned marks. Generic common body, prose equality, a desire for more groups or numeric target counts are insufficient. Check that neither prior reader already directly adjudicated it. Apply identical two-reader/final-source gates and disclose nonblind historical conditioning. Stop when no concrete new lead remains; uninspected available pairs are not physically missing information.
outputs: Compact versioned text/JSON correction-and-disposition delta with exact38 accounting, per-target source facts, exact historical pointers, actual direct-review coverage and a current-graph overlay only when supported. Reuse pinned D12 baseline and existing spatial307 refs; no repeated multi-megabyte historical reports. If no further772 lead meets admission, state zero additional pairs and the concrete limit. No alphabet letters/globalcipherstring.

publication.private_pixel_proof_policy: Publish only whole original-source/whole proof-JSON hashes, not per-panel/body/row pixel hash VALUES, masks, RLE or reconstructive arrays. No personal absolute paths, secrets, books, full Potter or private letters.
publication.qualifications: Separate AI review of same original pixels, not external expert validation. Default offline check verifies published bytes and declared gates without image/proof access.
